resources.string: Bubble for dictating and inserting text in any app

Embersay uses this service to show the dictation bubble and to insert your dictation into the field you\'re writing in. For that, it reads which app is open and whether a text field is selected (to show or hide the bubble), where the keyboard is (to keep the bubble clear of the keys), and, only while inserting a dictation, the text already in that field, so the new words fit in at the cursor. None of this is sent anywhere. On this phone, Embersay keeps which apps you dictated in, with word counts and timings, for your statistics. It also keeps your dictations (their text, app and time) for 24 hours, unless you change this or turn on security mode. Their text and app are encrypted and can only be read while the phone is unlocked, which needs a screen lock. Only your recording goes to the speech recognition you chose, and with cleanup on, its text goes to the cleanup you chose. Right after you turn on something in Android\'s settings that Embersay sent you to (this service, or unrestricted battery use), the service brings Embersay back to the front. Beyond that, it never taps, swipes or acts for you.
